profile.headline: Software Engineer & Architect (ex-Apple, ex-AWS) | Building  Askimo | AI-Driven Workflow & Developer Productivity
profile.summary:
I’m currently building two open-source projects - FlowInquiry and Askimo  both focused on helping teams and developers work smarter through open technology.

FlowInquiry is a lightweight, self-hosted platform for request and project management. It helps teams organize internal tickets and external support, plan sprints and iterations, automate workflows, and stay SLA-compliant - an affordable, open alternative to tools like Jira or Zendesk.

Askimo is an AI-powered developer assistant for local and enterprise environments. It connects to multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, etc.), supports local file tools, and offers programmable commands for code review, documentation, and workflow automation. Askimo is designed to help developers and small teams integrate AI into everyday coding - efficiently and privately.

Both projects reflect my goal of supporting digital transformation and AI adoption for small and medium-sized businesses through open-source innovation.

Medium stories: https://medium.com/@hai79

Core expertise:

  Enterprise architecture and design patterns

  Refactoring complex legacy systems

  High-performance and distributed computing

  Microservices, DevOps, and cloud platforms

  Code quality, automation testing, CI/CD

  Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, startups)

  Programming languages: Java, Kotlin, Scala, Python, TypeScript
